title: Pharos run request (pharos-run/1)
description: Written by Pharos for each run. Its path is the last argument of the command and is also in PHAROS_REQUEST; api.url and api.token are also in PHAROS_API and PHAROS_TOKEN. Scripts ignore fields they do not know: fields may be added within version 1.

run_id.description: Unique per run; exporters use it as the idempotency key for deliveries.

deadline.description: Pharos stops the run's process group at this time. Stop earlier and report partial.

dry_run.description: Do everything except deliver (exporters) or expect the drop to be discarded (importers). Used by pharos plugin test and previews.

limits.description: This run's limits, in plain units. Every one is enforced.

max_bytes.description: Bytes the run may write to output_dir, result.json included.

api.description: The connector API and this run's token, valid until the run ends. Importers get one with no read scopes.

output_dir.description: An empty folder for the run's output. result.json goes here; importers put drops here.

cursor.description: The cursor of the last acknowledged run, or null for the first run, after a reset, or after the receiver asked for everything.

params.description: The person's values for the manifest's params, verbatim.

as_of.description: Exporters: the run's cutoff; also in /grant.
